record.title: Evaluate paired-read consistency and fixed-source stock variability
record.intent: Narrow the failed return-control question without inventing a physical cause or accepting missing comparison arms.
requirements: Independently compare exact original paired response bytes and unchanged whole-record/default receive/comparison statistics for every supplied record. Report all planned positions, missing/partial pairs, every pair mismatch and the complete sampled RMS distribution. Do not introduce a low-RMS exclusion threshold, new fit or corrected baseline.

Equal pairs establish repeatable readout only for those frozen acquisitions; differing pairs establish nominally stopped readout instability or hidden-state ambiguity, not a proven source/ADC cause. Variation between equal pairs remains upstream/acquisition ambiguity. Reconcile physical source/stock lineage, capture reconstruction and restoration; retain the failed original A1 and fifty missing B/A2 slots.

State the exact next bench question or bounded offline continuation from actual evidence and remaining time. No native transition follows from this diagnostic. Preserve the tighter authorization deadline, known-safe ordinary/owned helper state and clean pushed checkpoint; do not extend the window or silently modify the frozen seventy-five-slot comparison.
acceptance: The paired diagnostic determines an explicit next research boundary without overstating physical fidelity.
